title: Plan mode, permissions and auto mode

folds.text: A **permission mode** decides what Claude can do without asking you first. Press `Shift+Tab` in the terminal to cycle through the modes. Which ones you see can vary by setup.
**Manual** asks before edits and commands. **Accept edits** lets Claude change files and do simple file chores without asking, but still asks about other commands.
**Plan mode** makes Claude read and propose, but not edit your source files. Edits stay blocked until you approve the plan. It suits exploring before changing.
**Auto mode** lets a separate safety check review actions, blocking risky ones instead of asking you. It cuts down on prompts, but it is not a guarantee. Skip it for sensitive work.
A mode that skips all prompts exists too. The docs say to use it only in isolated environments like containers or virtual machines, never on your everyday machine.

folds.prompt: Which mode fits? Tap the basket.
